title: The Ichinose Family's Deadly Sins
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: After a car accident, all six members of the Ichinose family wake up with amnesia. Middle schooler Tsubasa returns home with his parents, sister and grandparents and slowly discovers that the family he cannot remember was far more fractured than it first appears.
life_message: It holds up facing a family's hidden wrongs honestly as the only way to rebuild real bonds.

content.note: A car accident frames the story; little combat (Wikipedia; AniList tags).
Sustained psychological unease and family secrets; AniList Tragedy 93%, MU Psychological genre, Wikipedia premise.
MU lists infidelity among the family's past problems (to verify); nothing explicit noted.
Bullying and a suicidal character in MU and AniList tags; not confirmed by a second kind of source (to verify).

Dignity vs honor.evidence: Conflict is worked out through confession and talk inside the family rather than personal retaliation (Wikipedia premise; to verify).

Order vs freedom.evidence: The household has expectations and roles the amnesiac members must relearn (AniList Family Life, Estranged Family).

Civic vs kin.evidence: Everything turns on the six Ichinose relatives and whether they remain a family (Wikipedia plot).

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Grandparents, parents and children each hold a place; the story questions how fairly elders used it (to verify).

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: Little religion; the 'sins' are moral failings, not religious ones (title and MU categories).

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: Belonging and safety at home weighed against each person's honest self (to verify).

folkways.japan: The multigenerational household, the weight of family reputation and reluctance to air problems outside the home reflect common Japanese family norms, which the story examines.

delivery.evidence: No source comments on delivery; carried by character choices per AniList and entry notes (to verify)
delivery.note: The family's hidden wrongs surface through the amnesia mystery, letting readers weigh denial against honesty.

winners_losers: Sympathy goes to Tsubasa and family members willing to face what they did; denial and keeping up appearances are shown as costly.
